assertions.claim: Pooled over 33 studies, 15.04% of plastic-surgery candidates meet body dysmorphic disorder criteria — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 去做整形手术的人里有 15.04% 符合躯体变形障碍

assertions.claim: BDD described as a defect others barely notice magnified until it disrupts life — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 就是把一个别人基本看不出来的缺陷放大到影响生活

assertions.claim: Surgery changes the face but not the checking-dissatisfaction loop, easily leading to one operation after another — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 手术改的是脸，不改那个「反复检查、反复不满意」的循环，就容易一台接一台做下去

assertions.claim: Authors recommend plastic surgeons and dermatologists actively assess, identify high-risk individuals and arrange multidisciplinary care — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 作者建议整形外科医师与皮肤科医师主动评估、识别高风险者并安排多学科处理

assertions.claim: The item does not claim cosmetic-medicine seekers are psychologically troubled — the vast majority are not; it targets the small repeating, persistent, life-impairing group whom surgery does not help — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 本条不是说想做医美的人有心理问题，绝大多数不是

assertions.claim: Orientation cues: long daily checking or hiding of one area, avoiding social contact or photos, moving to the next spot after finishing one — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 一天里花很长时间检查或遮挡某个部位、因此回避社交或拍照、做完一处又盯上下一处
